data.note: Fill rules are the flags the engine recorded at each fill (backtest/position.py): intrabar policy stop_first decides a bar where the stop and a target were both touched. Costs are the ledger's own decomposition, in the account currency.

rule_definitions.both_touched: The stop and a target were both inside one bar's range; the intrabar policy decided which filled (the path inside a bar is unknowable).
rule_definitions.entry_stale: The ENTRY bar was stale (see stale).
rule_definitions.gapped: The bar OPENED through the level: a stop filled at the worse open (gap loss taken), a target at the level (no gap gift).
rule_definitions.plain: The level was touched inside the bar and nothing else applied.
rule_definitions.stale: The bar arrived after a gap of more than the profile's stale multiple of the bar interval; the fill paid the stale spread multiple.

source.detail: Research ledger backtest bt_0002, trade ledger.
